name: New Trustpilot reviews to Google Sheets and Slack (Apify Trustpilot Reviews)

parameters.content:
## New Trustpilot reviews to Google Sheets and Slack

Every morning this workflow collects the reviews posted since the last run for a list of companies on Trustpilot, appends them to a Google Sheet and posts one summary message to Slack.

### How it works
1. **Get new reviews** runs the Apify actor `arcadium/trustpilot-reviews` (Trustpilot Reviews Scraper by Arcadium Data) in only-new mode: it remembers delivered reviews under `stateKey`, so each run returns only reviews of the last 7 days (`dateFrom`) that it has not delivered before. Repeats are free.
2. **Reviews to rows** keeps review rows and picks the columns.
3. **Append to Google Sheets** writes one row per review.
4. **Slack summary** builds one message (counts per company, newest 1-2 star reviews) and **Post to Slack** sends it. No new reviews, no message.

### Set up
1. Install or enable the Apify node (`@apify/n8n-nodes-apify`) and add an **Apify API** credential.
2. Edit `companies` in **Get new reviews** (domains or Trustpilot review page URLs). Keep `stateKey` stable.
3. Create a sheet tab **Reviews** with this header row: `reviewId | date | company | rating | title | text | companyReply | verified | language | edited | url | scrapedAt`. Then add Google Sheets and Slack credentials; set the channel.
4. Execute once (the first run writes the last 7 days of reviews), then activate.

### Cost
$0.00052 per review on the Free Apify plan at the time of writing; repeats are not charged. The node caps a run at $0.50.

parameters.customBody:
{
  "companies": [
    "www.bestbuy.com",
    "www.newegg.com"
  ],
  "maxReviewsPerCompany": 100,
  "sort": "recency",
  "dateFrom": "7 days",
  "onlyNewReviews": true,
  "stateKey": "n8n-new-reviews",
  "markEdited": true,
  "includeCompanyInfo": false,
  "includeCoverageRows": false,
  "includeErrorRows": true
}
